body:
The stamp on the request slip sent my heart racing as I stared at the paper in disbelief. Each heartbeat felt like an echo of the impending doom. My palms were sweaty, fingers trembling slightly. I could feel the tension building up inside me, threatening to overwhelm me.

Thoughts raced through my head - was this some kind of prank? Could they be wrong about my documents being invalid? Panic crept in, not just from the refusal itself but also from the realization that any mistakes here could mean significant consequences for everything I hold dear.
